landing.sub: A rider collects your device, our technician repairs it and a rider brings it back. Every handover, quote and payment is recorded and visible to you.
landing.step1: Book online and pay the pickup fee
landing.step1d: Describe the device and the fault, add photos, and choose a pickup time.
landing.step2d: Scan the rider's QR code at your door: that is your proof of what left your hands.
landing.step3d: The technician diagnoses, you get an itemised quote. Accept, decline or negotiate in the app.
landing.step4d: Track the repair, pay the balance by M-Pesa and a rider returns it, or collect at the shop.
landing.pricesNote: Indicative prices including VAT. Your quote follows diagnosis.
landing.heroSub: Doorstep pickup. Expert repair. Returned to your hand. Every step verified, photographed and paid by M-Pesa.
landing.trust1d: You scan the rider at your door. That scan is your receipt.
landing.trust2d: Before pickup, at the bench and after the repair.
landing.trust3d: Accept, decline or make an offer. Nothing starts without you.
landing.trust4d: Straight to the shop. Receipts on your phone.
landing.bandBody: From the moment a rider collects it to the moment it is back in your hand, every handover, quote, payment and update is timestamped and visible to you.
landing.footerNote: Prices include VAT where applicable. Delivery by independent couriers.

job.title: Repair {ref}
job.scanRiderHelp: Ask the rider to show their QR code, then point your camera at it.
job.otpHelp: If the camera does not work, ask the rider for the 6-digit handover code.
job.handoverInvalid: That code does not belong to the rider assigned to this delivery.
job.intakeMatches: The technician confirmed your device matches what you declared.
job.intakeDiscrepancies: The technician noted differences from what you declared:
job.acknowledge: I acknowledge this and want to proceed
job.rejectIntakeHelp: Your device will be returned. The return delivery fee applies, and you can raise a dispute with the shop.
job.roundsNone: No more counter-offers: accept or decline.
job.declineConfirm: Decline this quote? Your device will be returned and the return delivery fee applies. The consultation fee is not refunded.
job.supplementaryHelp: The technician found extra work needed. Approve or decline it; the repair continues either way.
job.dropoffCollect: I will collect at the shop (no delivery fee)
job.collectionHelp: Show this at the shop counter.
job.notAsExpectedHelp: Tell us what is wrong. The shop will contact you.
job.cancelFee: A rider is already booked. Cancelling now will not refund the pickup fee.
job.orCollect: or collect at the shop for free

bench.receiveHelp: Scan the rider's QR or enter the delivery code to confirm the device has arrived.
bench.intakeHelp: Compare the device with what the customer declared. Record every difference with a photo.
bench.identifierMismatch: Does not match what was declared
bench.intakeWithDiscrepancies: Complete intake and ask the customer to acknowledge
bench.passcodeNotShared: Customer did not share the passcode.
bench.dispatchHelp: Scan the rider's QR code when they collect the device.
bench.collectionHelp: Ask the customer for the collection code shown in their app.
bench.cancelJobHelp: Cancelling records the reason and, if the device is here, starts a return.
bench.scannerHelp: Scan a rider QR code. The job is matched automatically.
bench.noCamera: Camera unavailable. Enter the code manually.
